IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: TO EXPAND THE PROMISE OF WORKER OWNERSHIP TO COMMUNITIES MOST AFFECTED BY SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC INEQUALITY.
IRS990.MissionDesc: THE MISSION OF THE DEMOCRACY AT WORK INSTITUTE IS TO EXPAND THE WORKER COOPERATIVE MODEL TO REACH COMMUNITIES MOST DIRECTLY AFFECTED BY SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC INEQUALITY, SPECIFICALLY PEOPLE OF COLOR, RECENT IMMIGRANTS, AND LOW-WAGE WORKFORCES. WE ARE A MOVEMENT-BASED THINK-AND-DO TANK SUPPORTING WORKER COOPERATIVES TO GROW TO A SCALE THAT CREATES MEANINGFUL CHANGE IN THE ECONOMY.
IRS990.Desc: RAPID RESPONSE COOPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT MODEL - THIS MODEL HELPS COOPERATIVES FORM AS LLCS WITH MEMBER BUY-IN, PROFIT DISTRIBUTION, AND DEMOCRATIC GOVERNANCE. IT USES FRANCHISE-LIKE ELEMENTS SHARED BACK-OFFICE SERVICES AND STANDARDIZED TRAINING THAT MAKE COOPERATIVES EASIER TO START AND ARE BETTER SUPPORTED AS THEY GROW.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: FISCALLY-SPONSORED PROJECTS - FISCALLY SPONSORED PROJECTS ALLOW MISSION-ALIGNED INITIATIVES TO ACCESS FUNDING. WE PROVIDE OVERSIGHT AND DISBURSE FUNDS INCREMENTALLY OVER THE COURSE OF THE GRANT PERIODS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: SCHOOL FOR DEMOCRATIC MANAGEMENT - AS A FIELD-BUILDING ORGANIZATION, DAWI IS COMMITTED TO ACCELERATING THE WORK OF THE NEXT GENERATION OF WORKER COOPERATIVE MEMBERS, MANAGERS, DEVELOPERS, AND REGIONAL PARTNERS BY FILLING CRITICAL GAPS IN WORKER COOPERATIVE EDUCATION VIA TRENDS IN ONLINE LEARNING, REGIONAL COOPERATIVE GROWTH, AND THE FIELD'S NEED FOR CULTURALLY-RELEVANT CONTENT.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION FOLLOWS THE AUTHORITATIVE GUIDANCE RELATING TO ACCOUNTING FOR UNCERTAINTY IN INCOME TAXES INCLUDED IN ASC TOPIC 740-10, INCOME TAXES. THESE PROVISIONS PROVIDE CONSISTENT GUIDANCE FOR THE ACCOUNTING FOR UNCERTAINTY IN INCOME TAXES RECOGNIZED IN AN ENTITY'S FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND PRESCRIBE A THRESHOLD OF "MORE LIKELY THAN NOT" FOR RECOGNITION AND DERECOGNITION OF TAX POSITIONS TAKEN OR EXPECTED TO BE TAKEN IN A TAX RETURN. IT IS THE ORGANIZATION'S POLICY TO RECOGNIZE INTEREST AND/OR PENALTIES RELATED TO UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS, IF ANY, IN INCOME TAX EXPENSES. THE ORGANIZATION PERFORMED AN EVALUATION OF UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS FOR THE YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024, AND DETERMINED THAT THERE WERE NO MATTERS THAT WOULD REQUIRE RECOGNITION ON THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS OR THAT MAY HAVE ANY EFFECT ON ITS TAX-EXEMPT STATUS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: GRANT FUNDS ARE MONITORED VIA QUARTERLY AND ANNUAL REPORTING OF THE GRANTEE TO DEMOCRACY AT WORK INSTITUTE AS LAID OUT IN GRANTEES' FISCAL SPONSORSHIP CONTRACT. REPORTING REQUIREMENTS MAY SHIFT BASED ON GRANT REQUIREMENTS, BUT INCLUDE DETAILED FINANCIAL REPORTING AND WRITTEN PROGRAM REPORTS ON GRANT DELIVERABLES.

DispositionOfAssetsDetail.AssetsDistriOrExpnssPaidDesc: EXPENDITURE OF ASSETS FOR EXEMPT PURPOSE

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: EXPLANATION OF INVOLVEMENT: THE DECREASE IN NET ASSETS OF MORE THAN 25% FROM THE PRIOR YEAR IS PRIMARILY DUE TO THE EBB AND FLOW OF MULTI-YEAR GRANTS THAT ARE RECOGNIZED AS REVENUE IN THE YEAR THEY ARE RECEIVED AND SPENT DOWN OVER SUBSEQUENT YEARS. THE ORGANIZATION HAD A HIGHER NUMBER OF SUCH GRANTS IN THE YEARS LEADING UP TO 2024, RESULTING IN HIGHER REVENUE IN PRIOR PERIODS AND CORRESPONDING REDUCTIONS IN NET ASSETS AS THOSE GRANT FUNDS WERE EXPENDED DURING 2024.

THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS DISCUSSES COMPENSATION AND DOCUMENTS THE DISCUSSION AND DECISION. THE PROCESS WAS LAST CONDUCTED IN FEBRUARY 2025.
